about: Census of businesses/shopfronts in the Grand Kifisia play area. Positions: OSM survey points where available, else an address geocoded on OSM house numbers, else the source's own coordinate snapped to the nearest street-facing facade. posErrM is an estimate (see docs/research/CENSUS.md). Not a 'verified' ground survey.

fields.open: true = believed open, null = unknown (old/unconfirmed listing), false = reported closed
fields.streetLevel: true = street-level shopfront likely, false = upper-floor office/practice likely (door plate, not a shop window), null = unknown
fields.posMethod: source = coordinate from the source (OSM, or Foursquare/Overture snapped to a facade); geocoded = from street + house number
fields.confidence: 0..1 that the business exists today at this place
fields.tier: A = confirmed (OSM survey, web-verified, or two fresh independent listings); B = one fresh listing (2023+ / Overture confidence >= ~0.45); C = old or weak listing, existence today unknown; X = reported closed. BUILD tiers A and B; C/X are history (use for vacant/'TO LET' fronts at most)
